name: Come, Ye Disconsolate
source:
Main character wakes up in a hospital with the whole body in pain. He survived in the accident, but Mitsuki died. What does memory hide?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在医院醒来，全身疼痛。他在事故中幸存下来，但三月却死了。记忆隐藏着什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
